name: beeswaxbind-webapp
description: BeeswaxBind: complete Full-stack app command-line tool example app. Self-hostable, Apache-2.0, built on cenius.ai.

paragraphs: Need a self-hosted command-line tool? BeeswaxBind is the open-source answer: a Full-stack app project you can clone, run, and own. BeeswaxBind is a single-file, standard-library-only Python command-line tool for leathercraft and saddlery work that does three jobs: recommend harness needle and linen thread sizes for a given thread number and leath…. Every BeeswaxBind line of code is here — no stripped demo, no paywalled features. Apache-2.0-licensed; remix BeeswaxBind on cenius.ai for a bespoke custom version.

▶ Open & edit in cenius.ai — one click to an editable workspace: describe changes in plain English, get an instant preview, one-click deploy and host. Modifications made on the platform come with full rebrand & relicense rights.
Local clone? See Quick start below. cenius.ai is the zero-setup path.
